description: Track paid sick leave accrued, available, used and carried over for one employee under a state preset or your own policy. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

carryIn.description: Hours carried in from last year (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for hours carried in from last year. Unknown is not the same as zero.

ctCap.description: Annual accrual cap (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for annual accrual cap. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 40 hours from Connecticut DOL paid sick leave FAQs, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when preset is ct; ignored otherwise.

ctCarry.description: Carryover cap (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for carryover cap. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 40 hours from Connecticut DOL paid sick leave FAQs, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when preset is ct; ignored otherwise.

ctPer.description: Hours worked per hour of leave (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for hours worked per hour of leave. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 30 hours from Connecticut DOL paid sick leave FAQs, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when preset is ct; ignored otherwise.

ctUse.description: Annual usage cap (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for annual usage cap. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 40 hours from Connecticut DOL paid sick leave FAQs, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when preset is ct; ignored otherwise.

ownCap.description: Annual accrual cap (your figure) (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for annual accrual cap (your figure). Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when preset is own; ignored otherwise.

ownCarry.description: Carryover cap (your figure) (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for carryover cap (your figure). Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when preset is own; ignored otherwise.

ownPer.description: Hours worked per hour of leave (your figure) (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for hours worked per hour of leave (your figure). Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when preset is own; ignored otherwise.

ownUse.description: Annual usage cap (your figure) (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for annual usage cap (your figure). Unknown is not the same as zero. Used only when preset is own; ignored otherwise.

pay.description: Hourly pay rate (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for hourly pay rate. Unknown is not the same as zero.

preset.description: Rules. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for rules. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: ct = Connecticut (2026: 11+ employees; 2027: 1+); own = Enter your own.

rounding.description: Accrual increments. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for accrual increments. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: fraction = Fractional hours; blocks = Only completed blocks.

used.description: Hours used this year (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for hours used this year. Unknown is not the same as zero.

worked.description: Hours worked this year (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for hours worked this year. Unknown is not the same as zero.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
